dl.err.aborted: The download was stopped. Press Retry to continue where it stopped.
dl.err.checksum: The downloaded file was damaged, so it was deleted. Press Retry to download it again.
dl.err.forbidden: The server refused the download (HTTP {status}). Press Retry later or choose another model; a network filter can also block it.
dl.err.http: The download failed (HTTP {status}). Press Retry later, or choose another model.
dl.err.install_failed: The download could not be unpacked. Press Retry.
dl.err.io: The file could not be saved. Check that the hivedesk folder can be written, then press Retry.
dl.err.load_failed: The model could not be loaded. Press Retry, or choose another model.
dl.err.locked: Another program is using the file, often an antivirus scan. Wait a moment or allow the hivedesk folder in the antivirus, then press Retry.
dl.err.needs_consent: Nothing downloads without your yes. Open the download again and accept it.
dl.err.no_disk: Not enough free disk space. Free some space or choose a smaller model, then press Retry.
dl.err.no_memory: Not enough free memory to load this model. Close other apps or choose a smaller model.
dl.err.no_network: No connection to the download server. Check the connection and press Retry; the download continues where it stopped.
dl.err.not_found: The file is no longer on the server (HTTP {status}). Choose another model, or update hivedesk.
dl.err.quarantined: The program was removed right after unpacking, most likely by an antivirus. Allow the hivedesk folder in the antivirus, then press Retry.
dl.err.rate_limited: The server asks to wait before the next download. Wait a little and press Retry.
dl.err.runtime_install_failed: The local runtime could not be installed. Press Retry; the reason is below.
dl.err.runtime_locked: The local runtime could not be installed because a file is in use. Close other hivedesk windows or wait for the antivirus, then press Retry.
dl.err.runtime_no_network: The local runtime could not be downloaded: no connection. Check the connection and press Retry.
dl.err.runtime_no_npm: The local runtime could not be installed: npm was not found. Reinstall hivedesk from the site, or connect another model in Settings.
dl.err.runtime_not_found: The local runtime is not available from npm right now. Press Retry later, or connect another model in Settings.
dl.err.server: The download server had a problem (HTTP {status}). Press Retry in a few minutes; the download continues where it stopped.
dl.err.too_big: This model has no valid size in the catalog. Choose another model.
voice.ui.errSttBlocked: Windows or an antivirus blocked the speech program. Allow it, or pick the CPU build in Settings, Voice.
voice.ui.errSttMissing: The speech program is missing, most likely removed by an antivirus. Allow the hivedesk folder in the antivirus and install it again in Settings, Voice.
voice.ui.errSttModel: The speech model file is damaged. Remove it and download it again in Settings, Voice.
voice.ui.errSttStart: The speech program could not start on this computer. Install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable, or pick the CPU build in Settings, Voice.
